## Checklist

- [ ] `xcodegen generate` and `xcodebuild` build without errors or new warnings
- [ ] `xcodebuild test` passes, and new `NotesStore` behavior has tests
- [ ] No generated files (`.xcodeproj`, build products) are committed
- [ ] UI changes were tried on a notched screen and, if relevant, an external display
- [ ] README or spec updated if behavior changed
